lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible. Immediately posterior to the gill slits, there is a high-density cluster of smaller spots which transitions into larger, more widely spaced blobs (~40-60 pixels apart) as the pattern moves posteriorly along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines of the pattern, creating a grid-like structure. The high-luminance blobs are primarily localized at these intersections, serving as anchor nodes within the grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom), running parallel to the shark's longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish, including a remora attached to the lower posterior flank and several smaller fish near the leading edge of the pectoral fin and mouth region. A unique high-density 'speckle' zone is visible in the pre-branchial area.
